SCCM1.label: Citation / Metrics

SCCM1.1.label: Citation Count Discrepancy
SCCM1.1.description: Definition: Citation counts differ from what the customer expects.

SCCM1.2.label: h-index Discrepancy
SCCM1.2.description: Definition: The h-index differs from what the customer expects.

SCCM1.3.label: CiteScore / Journal Metric Query
SCCM1.3.description: Definition: The customer asks about CiteScore or other journal metrics.

SCCM1.4.label: Missing Citations
SCCM1.4.description: Definition: Citations are not showing for a document.

SCCM1.5.label: CiteScore Data File Request
SCCM1.5.description: Definition: The customer asks for the CiteScore data file (Excel download of journal metrics).

SCCM1.6.label: Journal Metric Update Request
SCCM1.6.description: Definition: The customer asks for a journal's metric or source details to be updated.

SCCM1.7.label: Self-Citation Exclusion Issue
SCCM1.7.description: Definition: A question or problem about excluding self-citations from citation counts or the h-index.

SCCM1.8.label: Unknown / Not Stated
SCCM1.8.description: Definition: The metrics issue is not stated.

SCCM1.description: Every ticket in this task has already been classified at Level 1 as 'Citation / Metrics'. Choose the Level 2 value from this group only. 'Citation / Metrics' means: Definition: citation count, h-index, CiteScore/metric discrepancies and the CiteScore data file request (Citation / Metrics).
